tokens.name: page
tokens.usage: The ground everything sits on: behind the panes and the sidebar.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panes, cards, dialogs and fields: where content is read and written.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: Something set off inside a surface: an invitation, a quiet tag.

tokens.name: hover
tokens.usage: Behind a row or a quiet control the pointer is over, on surface.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Text and icons that matter, on page, surface and raised.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and resting icons, on page, surface and raised.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: The edge of a card or a field at rest.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows of a list, inside a surface.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: The edge of a control that can be pressed: an outlined button, an input.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one thing to do on a screen, links, and what is chosen.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Text on accent.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Behind what is selected: the current mailbox, the open conversation, Write.

tokens.name: accent-soft-text
tokens.usage: Text on accent-soft.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: What cannot be undone, and what went wrong.

tokens.name: danger-text
tokens.usage: Text on danger.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Behind an error notice; its text is danger.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: What worked.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Behind a success notice; its text is success.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: What needs a second look before going on.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Behind a warning notice; its text is warning.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The ring around whatever the keyboard is on.

families.sans: 'Hanken Grotesk Variable', 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', sans-serif

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Between an icon and its label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between controls in a row.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inside a compact control or a list row.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Inside a card; the gutter of a page on a phone.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between sections.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Around a page's content on a wide screen.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags, fields, small controls.

tokens.name: radius
tokens.usage: Buttons, cards, notices.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Panes, and Write.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pills, icon buttons, avatars.

tokens.name: shadow
tokens.usage: A card resting on the page.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: What floats over the page: a dialog, a toast, the compose window.
